blockers.statement: The retained Triton image carries a 12-DWORD (48-byte) descriptor preload and preload-aware mapping/entry semantics remain unimplemented; it must continue to fail closed.

CP26 proves only the exact hash-pinned zero-preload gpuReadWrite execution route. Normal Triton launcher/compiler/JIT transport, arbitrary gfx950 HSACO, performance, fallback, and Qwen inference remain unproven.

changes: Added negotiated GENERIC_EXECUTION_V2 at word-0 bit 9 while preserving bit-8 GENERIC_DISPATCH_V2 as the owner-bound control/admission/retire contract.

Connected the real VEGA_X86 daemon type-18 route through GPUDispatcher and ComputeUnit for the exact 5528-byte zero-preload gpuReadWrite fixture, with dispatch-id to wire-token translation, owner-bound buffers, physical-retire cleanup, and post-ACK quarantine.

Proved the independent A/B/C D2H oracle: four workgroups, sixteen wave64 waves, 304 instruction starts, 1024 reads, 2048 writes, 32 stores, signal 1->0 in the native private completion signal, output CRC32C 0x6f67026f, durable type-20, duplicate D2H, and UNMAP.
Kept the v1 MEMORY_COPY_H2D carrier and no KERNARG opcode; bit-8-only completion remains output CRC zero, while bit 9 requires the nonzero locked-fixture CRC.
limitations: The accepted execution proof is fixture-scoped to the exact 5528-byte gfx950 gpuReadWrite HSACO with zero descriptor preload; it does not generalize to arbitrary gfx950 or HSACO images.
The live daemon route is VEGA_X86. The separate HOSTGPU_NATIVE_CONTROL/CP20 B2 run is a functional differential and token/quarantine regression, not a standalone no-x86 daemon socket claim.
The wire signal_value_bits field remains expected 1 and signal_after_observed=false; trace signal_before=1/signal_after=0 is the native private AQL completion signal, not a wire after-value.

The positive endpoint is authoritative for bytes delivered by D2H; the fsynced daemon trace is authoritative for GPUDispatcher/CU execution and post-ACK quarantine. Client negative JSON does not prove remote cleanup.
Normal Triton launcher, compiler/JIT transport, 12-DWORD preload, arbitrary kernels, performance, CPU/NVIDIA fallback, and Qwen inference remain false and are next gates.
